### `server info`

Get initialization info for a connected server.

```bash theme={"theme":"css-variables"}

mcpjam server info --url https://your-server.com/mcp --access-token $TOKEN
```

Returns the server's `serverInfo` (name, vers

ion) and `capabilities` from the MCP initialize response.

### `server capabilities`
6.2.2", "stderr": "", "interrupted": false
